title: tisilia.explorer-registry
description: Input of `tisilia explorer build --registry` (a trusted registry of pre-installed codec modules bundled with the Explorer).

explorer.description: Directory of the Explorer package source (a package.json with a `build` script), relative to this file.

contract.description: Optional exported contract copied into the bundle as `contract` so that the static bundle can be viewed without a server.

manifest.description: Path of the module's tisilia.codec-manifest, relative to this file.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the manifest file bytes; the registry trusts exactly this manifest.

root.description: Directory the manifest's artifact paths are relative to (the application content root), relative to this file.
